name: Cut In Wall at Ceiling Line
intent: Wall painter establishes the wall-to-ceiling line freehand with a brush. Per doctrine, this edge is never taped — the wall painter cuts to the ceiling on every coat. This module fires once per coat. Coat 2 is ~25% faster than coat 1 because the painter follows the line already established on coat 1 (no fresh wander to fight).
doctrine: Freehand cut-in is the wall painter's most skill-intensive task. Coat 1 establishes the line (130 LF/hr baseline). Coat 2 runs ~25% faster (coat_2_rate_multiplier = 1.25) because the painter follows the line already on the wall — no fresh wander to correct. QT modifier slows the rate further at QT4/QT5 where the line must be dead straight under critical inspection. Height modifier applies because tall walls require ladder cut-in which is inherently slower than ground-level.
